briefs.name: Nashik Residential Apartments
briefs.instruction: Pathardi Phata, Nashik me hamare residential 2 & 3 BHK apartments ke liye 30-day Instagram campaign plan banao. Starting price 45 Lakhs, budget 25000/month.

briefs.name: Spice Route Bistro Opening
briefs.instruction: Koregaon Park, Pune me hamare new Mediterranean & North Indian restaurant opening ke liye Instagram campaign banao with 12 posts & 4 reels. Budget 20000.

briefs.name: Apex IIT-JEE Academy
briefs.instruction: Kota me hamare IIT-JEE & NEET coaching institute ke new batch admissions ke liye 30-day strategy banao. Location Vigyan Nagar, Kota, fees 1.2 Lakhs.

briefs.name: AdvertiseOS Agency Acquisition
briefs.instruction: BKC, Mumbai me hamari apni AI digital marketing agency AdvertiseOS ke client acquisition ke liye 30-day multi-channel campaign plan banao. Retainers from 35,000/month, budget 35000.
